newsitem.title: USA: Houston Exp. sets $75 million capital budget.
newsitem.headline: Houston Exp. sets $75 million capital budget.

text.p: Houston Exploration Co said on Thursday it plans a 1997 capital expenditures budget of $75 million for exploration and development.
That includes $39 million for exploration, mostly in the Gulf of Mexico, and $36 million for development and workover on offshore and onshore properties.
In 1996, Houston Exploration budgeted $27 million for exploration, $31 million for development and $120 million for acquisitions.
